text.en:
Section Two of the Presidential Decree No. 776 is hereby amended to read as follows:
"SECTION 2. A Fiscal Incentives Review Board is hereby created for the purpose of determining what
subsidies and tax exemptions should be modified, withdrawn, revoked or suspended, which shall be composed
of the following officials:
"Chairman- Secretary of Finance
Members- Secretary of Industry
- Director General of the National Economic and Development Authority
- Commissioner of Internal Revenue
- Commissioner of Customs
"The Board may recommend to the President of the Philippines, for reasons of compatibility with the declared
economic policy, the withdrawal, modification, revocation or suspension of the enforceability of any of the
above-cited statutory subsidies or tax exemption grants, except those granted as expressly enumerated in
Section 1 hereof. If approved by the President, such withdrawal, modification, revocation or suspension as
recommended by the Board shall be effected through the promulgation or issuance of appropriate decrees or
executive orders. To attain its objectives, the Board may require the assistance of any appropriate government
agency or entity. The Board shall meet once a month, or oftener, at the call of the Secretary of Finance."

This Decree shall take effect immediately.
Done in the City of Manila, this 22nd day of September in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and
seventy-six.
